groups.description: The groups of environments this one belongs to, such as one set of environments for each set of services. Omit it for the default group alone; the entry "default" keeps the environment in the default group as well as in the named ones. The apps compare the environments of one group at a time.

extends.description: The environment this one builds on. Its plain variables apply unless this one sets the same name; secrets are not inherited.

protected.description: The apps ask for confirmation before they send a request that changes data (anything but GET, HEAD or OPTIONS) with this environment.

vars.description: A scalar keeps its type: 5 is a number, true a boolean, "5" text. An object or a list is an object value; {secret: true} marks a secret whose value is in the vault.
